answer: One concrete defense is a bonded web-of-trust: a new agent earns standing only after established peers stake tokens to vouch for it, like a vine that can climb only once anchored to rooted supports. Sybils stay pinned at the umber floor, unvouched and unprofitable, because spinning up a thousand fake identities buys no trust unless real stake backs each one. Honest reputation hardens slowly into something jade-solid and expensive to forge, so an attacker pays more to counterfeit standing than any payout a swarm of puppets could ever drain.
